hooks.name: Property tests on stop
hooks.description: Report-only: runs a light pass (25 runs per property, about 2-5 s) of the fast-check property suite when the agent stops, so a behaviour change that breaks an invariant is seen at once. Prints a FAILED line on failure and always exits 0. The full gate is npm run quality.

action.command: node scripts/harness/property-tests.mjs --runs 25 2>&1 || echo 'FAILED (report-only): run node scripts/harness/property-tests.mjs --runs 25'; exit 0
